test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and0 relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : OLR :: LIO : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Given:** # : OLR :: LIO : %

Option 1) # = YTU, % = LKJ → YTU : OLR :: LIO : LKJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9415494a901003242508a88113186b4f3ae4f71092fa2bba838350f9bff97697.png] 

Option 2) # = ROU, % = IFL → ROU : OLR :: LIO : IFL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c1338019608571b67b3ef71a506fa3cb1564ff040e42190d40cd173e8d9d70.png] 

Option 3) # = RPO, % = MKP → RPO : OLR :: LIO : MKP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a32924d59a51370f97ccf949217e576bb4c9dc46ebd49d9f6e9d4b8fe0a6c540.png] 

Option 4) # = PKI, % = IMJ → PKI : OLR :: LIO : IMJ

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/681e7c9ba91302febff7977cb3a349abeff606470dc31c5bdacb3e47c40694ae.png] ​

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
